title: Accelerated rotors in a free housing

geometry.scope: as the balanced rotor pack starts accelerating

question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of B (spin) as the balanced rotor pack starts accelerating. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. With zero applied torque about the free axis, the housing must acquire angular momentum opposite to the driven pack. A positive, B negative. The requested motion is CCW (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.

options.label: B
options.explanation: B must be CCW. With zero applied torque about the free axis, the housing must acquire angular momentum opposite to the driven pack. A positive, B negative..

options.label: C
options.explanation: B must be CCW. With zero applied torque about the free axis, the housing must acquire angular momentum opposite to the driven pack. A positive, B negative..
